card.name: Linking words before infection or lung-inflammation terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, or, with, and/or) or the middle of a word, right before a named infection or lung condition such as pneumonitis, herpes simplex or latent infection. Seen in warnings about steroids and lung disease.

modes.label: Link before pneumonitis
modes.description: The word or, and/or or a word-ending right before pneumonitis after interstitial lung disease.
modes.example: Permanently discontinue pazopanib tablets in patients who develop interstitial lung disease (ILD)<< or>> pneumonitis.

modes.label: Link before infection term
modes.description: The word of or with right before an infection or eye-inflammation condition in steroid warnings.
modes.example: Employment of a corticosteroid medication in the treatment of patients with a history<< of>> herpes simplex requires great caution.

card.plain: It marks the small word just before a named infection or lung-inflammation condition in a warning.
